style: point the listener to one word to listen for

candidates.angle: azaram, again and again, shows no escape for the cruel
Krishna as the one who casts them down
The word asuri, demonic, marks the lowest destination

en.intro: Krishna draws a line between a life of cruelty and a life of peace. Listen for the word that tells us what happens to those who choose cruelty.
en.notice: Krishna names himself as the one who casts the hateful and cruel down. He does not let them drift; he sends them again and again into demonic births as the consequence of their own actions.
en.next: Those deluded beings born into shadowed births sink into a lower state and never reach the divine.
en.next_alt: Those who hate and harm are cast down into demonic births again and again, and never find the divine.
en.meaning: I cast those hateful, cruel, and vile people again and again into demonic births.

hi.intro: कृष्ण क्रूरता और शांति के बीच की रेखा खींचते हैं। सुनिए उस शब्द को जो हमें बताता है कि क्रूरता चुनने वालों का क्या होता है।
hi.meaning: उन द्वेष करनेवाले, क्रूर स्वभाववाले और संसारमें महान् नीच, अपवित्र मनुष्योंको मैं बारबार आसुरी योनियोंमें गिराता ही रहता हूँ ॥
hi.next: वे अज्ञानी जीव जो बार-बार अंधकारमय जन्म लेते हैं, वे कभी मुझ तक नहीं पहुँच पाते और नीच अवस्था में ही गिरते रहते हैं।

en.intro: Krishna draws a line between a life of cruelty and a life of peace. Listen for the word that tells us what happens to those who choose cruelty.
en.body: I cast those hateful, cruel, and vile people again and again into demonic births. Krishna names himself as the one who casts the hateful and cruel down. He does not let them drift; he sends them again and again into demonic births as the consequence of their own actions. Those deluded beings born into shadowed births sink into a lower state and never reach the divine.

hi.intro: कृष्ण क्रूरता और शांति के बीच की रेखा खींचते हैं। सुनिए उस शब्द को जो हमें बताता है कि क्रूरता चुनने वालों का क्या होता है।
hi.body: उन द्वेष करनेवाले, क्रूर स्वभाववाले और संसारमें महान् नीच, अपवित्र मनुष्योंको मैं बारबार आसुरी योनियोंमें गिराता ही रहता हूँ ॥ वे अज्ञानी जीव जो बार-बार अंधकारमय जन्म लेते हैं, वे कभी मुझ तक नहीं पहुँच पाते और नीच अवस्था में ही गिरते रहते हैं।

issues: meaning_changed: "उन द्वेष करनेवाले, क्रूर स्वभाववाले और संसारमें महान् नीच, अपवित्र मनुष्योंको मैं बारबार आसुरी योनियोंमें गिराता ही रहता हूँ।" (The Hindi translation adds the adjective 'महान्' (great) to 'नीच' (lowest), which contradicts the source word 'नराधमान्' (lowest among men). This changes the meaning from 'lowest among men' to 'greatest among the low/impure', which is a significant softening/alteration.)

meaning_changed: "कृष्ण स्वयं को वह बताते हैं जो द्वेष करने वालों और क्रूरों को नीचे गिराते हैं। वे उन्हें भटकने नहीं देते, बल्कि उनके कर्मों का परिणाम उन्हें बार-बार आसुरी जन्मों में भेजता है।" (The Hindi notice explicitly states that their own actions (कर्मों का परिणाम) send them into demonic births, whereas the Sanskrit source (अहम् क्षिपामि) attributes the casting directly to Krishna ('I cast'). This shifts the agency from God to the individuals, significantly altering the meaning.)

meaning_changed: "कृष्ण स्वयं कहते हैं कि वे उन द्वेष करने वालों और क्रूरों को नीचे गिराते हैं।" (The Hindi meaning uses the continuous present 'गिराता ही रहता हूँ' (I keep casting), while the notice changes it to a simple present 'गिराते हैं' (they cast), which shifts the meaning from Krishna's continuous action to a general statement. Additionally, 'वे उन्हें भटकने नहीं देते' (they do not let them wander) is an unsupported addition not present in the source.)

unsupported: "कृष्ण स्वयं कहते हैं कि वे उन द्वेष करने वालों और क्रूरों को नीचे गिराते हैं।" (The phrase 'वे उन्हें भटकने नहीं देते' (they do not let them wander) is an unsupported factual claim not found in the Sanskrit source or the known Mahabharata story.)

wrong_fact: "Notice: कृष्ण स्वयं उन द्वेष करने वालों और क्रूरों को नीचे गिराते हैं।" (The source text says 'I cast' (क्षिपामि), not that Krishna actively 'pushes' or 'throws down' them. The Hindi notice adds an active, physical pushing gesture ('नीचे गिराते हैं') that is not supported by the source.)

wrong_fact: "next: वे अज्ञानी जीव जो बार-बार अंधकारमय जन्म लेते हैं, वे कभी मुझ तक नहीं पहुँच पाते और नीच अवस्था में ही गिरते रहते हैं।" (The NEXT verse (20) says 'Those deluded beings, born again and again into shadowed births, never reach me and sink into a lower state.' The Hindi next misquotes the source by adding 'अंधकारमय' (dark) and 'अज्ञानी' (ignorant) which are not in the source, and changes 'sink into a lower state' to 'fall into a lower state' ('नीच अवस्था में ही गिरते रहते हैं').)
